name: Premužićeva staza
description_md:
Premužićeva staza is a 44.1 km walking route located in HR. This hard trail requires about 14 hours to complete based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route features 883 m of ascent and 1407 m of descent. It is part of a regional waymarked hiking network. The path passes Northern Velebit within 300 m.
